content.title: WWE fans enraged as Netflix hit with streaming issues during WrestleMania 42
content.text: Netflix is streaming two action-packed nights of WWE as WrestleMania 42 is underway at Las Vegas' Allegiant Stadium, however the stream has encountered technical difficultiesWWE fans are furious after Netflix encountered technical difficulties during the first night of WrestleMania 42.The two-day wrestling showcase kicked off on Saturday at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, featuring a star-heavy Night 1 card that includes appearances from IShowSpeed and Logan Paul. Former NFL punter turned ESPN personality Pat McAfee is also set to be involved, as Cody Rhodes defends the Undisputed WWE Championship against Randy Orton in the headline bout.As of early 2026, WWE shifted to a largely fragmented, streaming-led distribution model. Netflix now serves as the global home for Monday Night Raw in key markets including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Latin America, while also carrying WWE programming internationally. It also serves as the exclusive home of WrestleMania 42 outside of the U.S. It is the second time in little over a month that Netflix has struggled with a major event following issues during MLB's Opening Night.Football historian Steve Bolton analyses first footage of women's gameREAD MORE: Logan Paul brushes off possibility of 'washed-up' Tom Brady stealing WrestleMania spotlightREAD MORE: WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: How to watch Night 1 as Cody Rhodes set to defend title vs. Randy OrtonJust minutes before the stream was due to go live, Netflix crashed for a number of users. One X user said: "Obviously Netflix goes down before #Wrestlemania." Another user added: "Of course Netflix goes down minutes before WrestleMania."One WWE fan posted a photo of the error message which stated that the event was not able to be shown instantly despite being live. "Anyone else having problems when trying to watch Wrestlemania on Netflix?" they wrote.Many viewers said they had to search for the event and click on the latest episode, rather than being able to click watch live event on the homepage. Some fans are also experiencing problems with the stream being slow. "Netflix having a nightmare trying to stream Wrestlemania. My stream's lagging like crazy" wrote one viewer.You agree you are 18 or over. We use your sign-up to provide content in ways you've consented to and improve our understanding of you. To see all WWE programming, you have to have Netflix (Raw), cable (SmackDown), and ESPN+ (WWE PLEs). It's absurd."Both nights feature stacked cards as WWE works to conclude major long-term storylines and set the stage for the following Monday Night Raw, which traditionally includes NXT call-ups, surprise returns from legends, and potential debuts from outside talent.The company has transformed the week into a full-scale Las Vegas takeover, with events spanning WrestleMania weekend programming, SmackDown, the Hall of Fame ceremony, Raw after WrestleMania, and a five-day fan convention across the city.READ MORE: Furious ESPN viewers complain about WrestleMania 42 stream crashing just minutes inREAD MORE: Virginia Tech Spring Game chaos as pre-game parachuter collides with big screenJohn Cena ended his in-ring career in December at Saturday Night’s Main Event, falling to Gunther in what was billed as his final match. Cena had publicly stated he was done competing for good, bringing closure to a storied wrestling career.However, his retirement did not mark a full departure from the company. Cena returned to the franchise in a hosting role for WrestleMania 42 in his first appearance at a WWE event since stepping away from in-ring action.
